1153-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-progress.text:
I saw the travelers again--the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.
1153-progress.title: A New Ore Sample

816-progress.name: Misha Tor'kren
816-progress.text: I pray that Kron will return to me, but I'm almost certain I know his fate already.
816-progress.title: Lost But Not Forgotten

834-progress.name: Rezlak
834-progress.text: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
834-progress.title: Winds in the Desert

93680-accept.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
93680-accept.text:
The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.

That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!

While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
93680-accept.title: Key to the City

97282-progress.name: Rezlak
97282-progress.text:
It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder.

Well, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean.

Trust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.
97282-progress.title: Stormy Potential
